note: Each SAM mask's min/max box is scored as a detection (score 1) against the GT boxes of the training pool. The result is the box AP of a model that reproduces the SAM masks exactly: an approximate ceiling for EoMT trained on SAM masks and scored with mask-derived boxes against the (looser) GT boxes. Not strict: the test split has no SAM masks, and a model can learn boxes looser than SAM's.
